gothicvania.description: Cemetery, Church and Swamp. One artist, 16x16 tiles, 1x pixel density, dark gothic palette with local biome ramp shifts.

dungeon.description: ThePixelist castle dungeon. 16px platform strip and composite 32px masonry chunks, desaturated charcoal palette.

fantasyForest.description: KilluaKage Fantasy Forest. 16x16 grid, muted teal/green palette, dark ambient. Isolated by portal fade.
